subject: Plan selection and bundle options for 3-month pilot (MedLytics)
messages:
From: Clara Reyes <clara@medlytics.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@medlytics.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot plan selection questions — 3mo pilot scope

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — we left with a clearer idea but still have a few open questions before we sign the pilot SOW. Attached is a short doc with our estimated traffic. Quick summary / asks: 

- Pilot scope: 3 months, ~12M tokens/month (peak 30k concurrent requests across a handful of routes).
- We're evaluating either: a) Hosted API with Redwood Optimize enabled, or b) Dedicated capacity (1x reserved pool, burst to hosted), or c) Hybrid (dedicated for high-throughput routes + hosted fallback).
- Important features: token-level cost dashboard, per-route QoS, longer retention for traces (90 days), and optional quantized model profile (we'd like lower cost but need guidance on quality trade-offs).
- How would tier upgrade/downgrade be handled mid-pilot if our load grows? Any proration implications?
- Can you outline what would be bundled vs. add-on (observability retention, Optimize credits, quantization lab support)?

Can you put together a concise recommendation and pricing for each option? We're hoping to finalize commercial terms early next week.

Thanks,

Clara Reyes
Head of Platform Integrations | MedLytics
Attachments:
- medlytics_pilot_requirements.docx (doc)
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Reyes <clara@medlytics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-14T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot plan selection questions — 3mo pilot scope

Hi Clara — really appreciate the detail in the attach. I ran the numbers with our infra team and sketched three pragmatic paths based on your traffic profile:

Option 1 — Hosted + Optimize (fastest onboarding)
- Description: All traffic on Hosted API with Redwood Optimize (auto-batching, KV caching, quantization recommendations).
- Economics: Estimated blended unit cost = $X.XX per 1k tokens with Optimize; projected monthly spend ~ $YYk.
- Pros: Zero infra setup, instant skus, easy to scale.
- Cons: Less predictable throughput for sustained peaks; fallback relies on regional capacity.

Option 2 — Dedicated Reserved Pool (throughput-first)
- Description: 1 reserved GPU pool sized for baseline 12M tokens/mo with burst to Hosted for spikes.
- Economics: Monthly reserved fee + lowered per-token execution cost; effective blended cost ~ $Z.ZZ per 1k tokens.
- Pros: Predictable latency/SLOs, better throughput and cost at sustained load.
- Cons: Setup lead time (1–2 weeks), commit required for reservation window.

Option 3 — Hybrid (route-level routing) [recommended for pilot]
- Description: Place the top 3 high-throughput routes on Dedicated, everything else on Hosted. Smart routing keeps latency critical paths on reserved capacity while preserving headroom.
- Economics: Mix of the two; modeled in attached workbook.
- Pros: Best balance of predictability and time-to-value; easier incremental upgrade/downgrade.

Tier upgrade/downgrade mechanics
- Mid-pilot upgrades: immediate effective capacity increase (prorated charge for additional reserved capacity for remainder of billing month).
- Downgrades: allowed at month boundary with 30-day notice; reserved capacity commitments are prorated only downward at monthly boundaries (no retroactive refunds).

Bundle vs add-on clarity
- Included in base pilot package: API access, basic observability (30d), Optimize suggestions.
- Add-ons: extended observability retention (90d), dedicated quantization lab support (model profiling + A/B), telemetry export to S3/BigQuery.
- Suggested pilot bundle: include 90d retention as a paid add-on at a discounted pilot rate (see pricing tab).

Concessions we can offer for a first commercial pilot
- Pilot discount: 20% off list unit pricing for the first 3 months.
- Onboarding credits: $5k in provisioning/consulting credit toward model profiling and routing setup.

I attached a short workbook with the cost math and a recommended baseline configuration (20260914-nikhil-tier-recommendation.xlsx). Lauren (cc'd) will follow up on commercial language & SOW. Happy to do a 30-min workshop to finalize routing rules tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments:
- 20260914-nikhil-tier-recommendation.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Reyes <clara@medlytics.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot plan selection questions — 3mo pilot scope

Hi Clara — quick commercial follow-up from our side. Appreciate Nikhil's clear options. Per internal approval (Marcus looped for finance sign-off), we can firm up the pilot offer as follows: 

Commercial offer (final draft)
- Pilot term: 3 months, starting on signature date.
- Pricing: 25% pilot discount off list for the first 3 months (upgrade from the 20% initial suggestion).
- Credits: $7,500 onboarding credit for model profiling + routing workshop (applies to SOW work only).
- Observability: 90d retention included for pilot (no extra charge).
- Quantization lab: offered as a one-time engagement (flat fee $6,000) or apply onboarding credits.
- Upgrade path: if you decide to reserve Dedicated capacity mid-pilot, reserved pricing kicks in immediately and is prorated for the remainder of the billing period; any unused onboarding credits can be applied to the upgrade engineering time.

Next steps
1) If acceptable, I'll prepare a short SOW and an execution DocuSign for signature.
2) We can schedule the routing workshop after signature (Nikhil will run).

Internal note: Marcus agreed to the extra $2,500 in onboarding credit on the basis that the pilot has a high likelihood to convert to a Dedicated deal given their profile.

Thanks — Lauren Bishop
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments:

Lauren / Nikhil — this looks good and thank you for moving so quickly. We accept the pilot commercial terms as outlined (25% pilot discount, $7.5k onboarding credit, 90d retention included).

Please send the SOW + DocuSign link and we will route internally for signature today. We expect to start the workshop within 3 business days of signature.

Clara Reyes
